thread:
Rachel (People Ops): Hey team — launching a Peer Appreciation Bingo week next Tue-Thu to boost inter-team shoutouts. Idea: bingo card with small actions (send a kudos, help a PR, coffee chat) + sticker prizes + 3 gift cards for completed lines. Signup form: https://forms.gle/peer-bingo-signup :tada:
Alex (Eng): love it. i can run the table on Wed lunchtime. need a tiny checklist for volunteers? :coffee:
Maria (Design): I can make the bingo card and stickers. working on a few sticker mockups, will drop in #design-review in a bit.
Jamal (SWE): happy to MC the quick prize draws. do we want a 12pm and 3pm slot?
Sasha (Finance): quick Q — do we have a budget for prizes and stickers? also payroll cutoffs if we do spot awards?
Rachel (People Ops): Budget: $500 for stickers/prizes plus 3 $25 gift cards. Spot awards — yes we can tie 2 surprise spot awards to the event, but approvals must hit me by Fri EOD (payroll note: cutoff is next Tues 9am).
Alex (Eng): noted — i'll marshal volunteers. who can bring tablecloths/markers?
Maria (Design): i'll order 200 stickers from StickerCo. approve mockup if ppl +1? (link to mockup)
Jamal (SWE): Alex + me can bring markers and a laptop to run the raffle list.
Sasha (Finance): approved for $500 spend. pls include invoice/email for bookkeeping. Rachel — i'll need a quick line item list before purchase.
Rachel (People Ops): will post a tiny purchase sheet: item / est cost / owner. I'll also put a calendar block for the 3-day event.
people-ops-bot: Reminder — room booking required for "Commons Table" on Wed 11:30-1:30. Use /book-room to reserve.
Alex (Eng): reserved Commons Table for Wed 11:45-1:15. screenshot attached. :thumbsup:
Maria (Design): mockup v2 uploaded — changed color + added Redwood leaf icon. tagging @Rachel for final signoff.
Rachel (People Ops): signoff given. Maria, go ahead with the sticker order and include mailing to NYC + SF offices. Please CC finance.
Sasha (Finance): got it. once invoice is in, i'll code to "Events - Culture".
Jamal (SWE): small logistics: can we have a digital bingo PDF for remote folks? then we can add a slack thread for submissions.
Rachel (People Ops): yes — Maria pls export a PDF and I'll create a remote-submissions channel thread. We'll run remote draws Thu 5pm.
Alex (Eng): volunteers: me, Jamal, Priya (ops) for Wed. Priya can help with sticker distribution.
Rachel (People Ops): perfect. final to-dos: Maria order stickers by EOD Tue, Alex confirm volunteers, Sasha await invoice, Rachel to submit purchase request and create remote thread. Any other blockers?
Maria (Design): none from design. thanks!
Sasha (Finance): none.
people-ops-bot: Event "Peer Appreciation Bingo" created: Apr 2-4. Participants: 200 expected. Automated reminder scheduled for Apr 1.
